en-US.description: Visual API testing and load-testing workbench for HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, SSE, and Kafka
en-US.longDescription:
RedfireForge is a free, open-source desktop application for API testing and performance testing.
It supports HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, SSE, and Kafka in a single workbench.
Features include a visual workflow designer, built-in API mock server, parameterized load testing,
a data mapper, and a CLI for CI/CD integration.
en-US.name: RedfireForge
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- Kafka Consumer Groups — Topics → Consumer Groups opens with a count of how many times each group ID appears, then the existing detail table. Each section can shrink or expand on its own.
This release includes Standard (RedfireForge_*) and Learning Hub (RedfireForge-LearningHub-*) installers.
macOS: Gatekeeper will block the app on first launch. Run once in Terminal after installing:
- Standard: xattr -cr /Applications/RedfireForge.app
- Learning Hub: xattr -cr "/Applications/RedfireForge Learning Hub.app"
  Windows: If SmartScreen appears, click More info → Run anyway.
  Linux: sudo dpkg -i *.deb or chmod +x *.AppImage && ./*.AppImage
SHA256 checksums are in SHA256SUMS.txt above.
